t_advice_summary_textbox.text: tbere seems to be 2 groups of the gnomes, one group pays higher and one group pays lower. stick with the same group until the payout of mushrooms change

vb_textbox.text: there seems to be two groups of gnomes. blue, orange, yellow and green in one group and red, pink, brown and purple in the other. mushrooms seem to payout with a group for some time so when you notice the higher payout, try to stay to that group until you notice the payout drop. im not 100% sure but there seems to be a pattern sometimes in the mushrooms numbers. i couldnt work this out, however if you seem to notice a pttern you may be able to work out when the payout changes group before this happens. good luck
